title: World Bloom — Ordinary, Yet Special Us — Episode3 Distant

meta.Event Outline: Things have been going well for Leo/need since their professional debut. One day, a change in the tree in their SEKAI brings them to a dream world—one where they never became estranged.

rows.Line: se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Yawn*

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I definitely stayed up too late watching Jam Fest.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But Shiho and her band were worth seeing since they were so cool...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Morning, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Morning, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Whoa! Y-You scared me...
Morning, you two.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha! Does this mean our prank worked?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We weren't trying to scare you or anything.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, I didn't expect you to be so startled.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was spacing out since I stayed up a little too late last night. But I'm wide awake now thanks to the both of you...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, you stayed up late?
Doing what? Tell us!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Watching the Jam Fest stream.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I wanted to commit all of your best moments to memory while I still had access to the archived footage.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
And STANDOUT was just the coolest!
Even though I was watching on a screen, I got really excited just listening to your guys' performance!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks. I thought we did pretty well, but hearing someone say that does give me a nice boost of confidence.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, since you saw the stream, that means you probably know about our homecoming show.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah. I really want to go to this one.
I want to see you and your band perform in person.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But STANDOUT's had a lot of fans since they were still an indie band, so getting tickets won't be easy.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: About that. Want me to see if I can get you in as an invited guest?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, you can do that?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ I just asked her to do the same for me a second ago! I hope we all get to go!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
Could you ask Honami about the show for me?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure thing. I'll ask her once our morning homeroom's done.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks, I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Speaking of Hona, I haven't seen her in the classroom at all lately...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She wasn't there when I went over to borrow that textbook last week.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's been busy having discussions about her future. She spends her lunches and all her other breaks in the career counselor's or teachers' office asking for their advice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right. She's already looking for universities to attend.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm so impressed by just how much Honami's already thinking about her future...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It took seeing the three of you work so hard before I finally started to wonder what I should do.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You deserve some credit for actually acting on that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, it takes a lot of guts to visit all those clubs during your second year. I find that really impressive.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What she said! I was so happy when you came over to visit the soft tennis club!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks. But I didn't end up joining...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are you still visiting different clubs?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, I've stopped doing that.
These days, I'm...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, there's the bell. Sorry, I'll tell you next time. And I'll make sure to let Honami know about your show!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, thanks.
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Boo, I really wanna know what she was gonna say now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sure she'll tell us soon.

rows.Speaker: Math Teacher
rows.Line: Now, trigonometry involves memorizing quite a lot of these identities, but you'll become familiar with them as you work through these problems.

rows.Speaker: Math Teacher
rows.Line: So, for this next practice problem... Tenma, can you solve it for us?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (She'll tell us soon, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (When's that gonna be...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We haven't had lunch together in a really long time, and we basically only talk whenever we just happen to see each other.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (To be fair, I haven't been able to have lunch with them because I have to practice and stay on top of my work correspondence...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But work is work.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We can't always be together like when we were still in junior high.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (If anything, we might've spent too much time together back then...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (That made sense during our first year since we were all put in the same class.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (When we became second-years, only Saki and Honami were put in the same class. But I remember Saki coming by to visit basically every day.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Because of that, whenever she didn't show up, my classmates would start asking, “Where's Tenma today?” or, “Are you guys having a fight right now?”)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (There were even times when I went over to visit her to see if she forgot to do her homework or something.)

rows.Speaker: Math Teacher
rows.Line:
Yes, Tenma, that's correct.
You may return to your seat.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay! I did it! Peace!
se_event_wl_2nd_lightsound_2025_003

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But it's natural for our friendship to change as we begin pursuing different things in life...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The four of us haven't really been hanging out much lately, but it's not like things have soured between us.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I just need to keep fulfilling my duties as a pro.)
A few days later
Record Company

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Alright, that concludes today's meeting.
Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Okay, we'll see you for our next one.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Oh, Shiho, before I forget.
The sample for “REAL STAGE” came in. Have you seen it already?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, not yet.
It's going on sale pretty soon, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honestly, I can't believe that I get to be on the cover of the magazine I've been reading ever since I was little...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line:
Me neither.
It sort of all hit me when I saw the sample.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: That happened to me during our shoot.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Actually, Mio, didn't you say that you were so nervous during the shoot that you don't really remember what happened?

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: I mean, I've been dreaming about being in that magazine for so long...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
But it was the same for that other shoot where you...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: S-Stop it, Iori...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll get used to it soon. After all, it sounds like we're going to be doing a lot more shoots in the future.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: This company is marketing us pretty hard.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: That being said, Shiho, you can only do so much since you're still in high school.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sorry about that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But our school has a credit-based course, so if I switched over to that...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Oh, things are fine the way they are.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: I'm actually kind of glad since we get to slowly accustom ourselves to life as pros.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Also, didn't our manager tell you to cherish your time at school? Remember that talk about how there are certain things you can only do while you're a student?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I plan to stay on top of my schoolwork.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: No, I think that was about hanging out with friends and participating in school events.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Right. You're really close with your childhood friends, so you should all create lots of wonderful memories together while you're still in high school.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know we should, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I feel like we made plenty of memories during junior high.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: But there's certain things you can only do right now. For example, this is the time of year for... Oh, what about the school festival?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Whoa, I remember those...
I performed on stage in the gym with my old band.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Shiho, you and your friends also used to be in a band together, right? Why don't you all play at the school festival?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: “Used to” was way back in elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Besides, I have to keep practicing for our band, while club activities and stuff keep the others really busy too.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Right, club activities.
Things can get busy when you take what you're doing really seriously.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: I remember my friends always telling me how they were too busy to hang out.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I know it's just the school festival, but I'm a pro now. I don't want to put on a half-hearted performance...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (On the other hand, putting on a good performance would mean having to ask Ichika and the others to practice a lot.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (That'd be asking too much of them.)
I'm glad music... No, I'm glad you found a way back to your friends, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (What happened just now? I thought I heard a voice in my head...)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Shiho? Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, no... It's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: In any case, you should cherish your friends and your time as a student.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: We'll keep doing stuff together as a band going forward, but you only have so much time left as a high schooler.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, I'll do what I can to make the most of this time...
A few days later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I wonder what we're going to do during today's long homeroom...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I hope it ends early since I need to practice for that show.)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Alright, let's get today's long homeroom underway. It's time for you all to start preparing for the school festival.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: First, you'll need to decide what you're going to do as a class.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The school festival, huh...?
